method: Built-in GPT Image 2 generation; transparent cutouts; actual Little Gods cel 16-colour reduction and VTracer SVG conversion; actual palette mapper, vector-art mesh renderer and ColorGradingPass.
references: Little Gods Warden, Solis, Cryos and village artwork, used as inspiration for new images

prompts.locations:
Create NEW original artwork for Little Gods, a fantasy god-and-village game. Reference image 1 shows its three gods and architecture: Warden with leaf mask and curled woodland roofs, Solis with simple oval mask and sun ring and round clay architecture, Cryos with dark hood, two glowing eyes, pointed frost crown and steep shelters. Use these identities as inspiration, do NOT paste or trace these existing sprites. Reference image 2 is only inspiration for the quiet hand-inked map aesthetic.
PRODUCTION ATLAS: exact 3 rows × 3 columns, nine separate isolated assets, equal square cells, wide transparent gutters and actual transparent background. Each fully contained in its own cell.
STYLE IS FLAT SVG ART: bold irregular curvy warm-brown pen outlines; very simple closed flat colour shapes; only 6–8 broad shades per asset. Playful wonky proportions and strong readable silhouettes. NO tiny rendering, no realistic texture, no hatching, no individual roof tiles or brickwork, no gradients, no detailed fantasy concept painting. Think little hand-drawn map emblems of places, readable at 140 pixels.
Palette throughout is cohesive restrained warm sepia: brown ink #663931 and #8f563b, tan #d9a066, cream #fbe7d4 and pale parchment. Dark marks sparse, mainly outlines. No black areas, vivid orange, saturated yellow, green, blue or purple. Express each god through architecture and symbols instead of separate bright colour palettes.
Row 1 left: HEARTH VILLAGE, three tiny rounded woodland cottages with curling leaf roofs around a little carved leaf-mask shrine. One curved fence. Cozy place to begin a journey.
Row 1 middle: WARDEN'S GROVE, two sweeping old tree trunks forming a natural arch around a large simple cream leaf-mask carving. One little lantern under an arch. Sacred woodland location.
Row 1 right: SOLIS VILLAGE, two round clay huts and a small circular sun court, a large sun-ring over the central arch bearing a simple oval face with two black eye slits. Warm cream domes, brown cloth awnings.
Row 2 left: FALLEN SHRINE, a broken large mask-shaped shrine arch and three small fallen stone fragments. A little curved stair. Unsettling but charming, sparse and readable.
Row 2 middle: CRYOS PASS, a tiny village of two steep triangular frost shelters under a pointed crown-shaped mountain arch. Snow rendered as warm pale cream, deep brown window hollows and two tiny amber lights, no blue. God identity from triangular hood and crystal silhouette.
Row 2 right: OLD SANCTUARY, an ancient circular stone sanctuary with three simple mask stones together: leaf, oval sun, pointed hood. A short approach of four oversized stepping stones. Memorable final destination, the three gods' motifs visibly united.
Row 3 left: two little wind-bent stylized trees with rounded curling foliage in tan.
Row 3 middle: one broad gnarled oak, very simple cream/tan foliage masses and brown curved trunk.
Row 3 right: three small rounded boulders with ONE broad shadow colour, no cracks or texture rendering.
Do not render cast shadows, elliptical shadows, ground discs, floating terrain islands or thick diorama bases. Tiny contact ink at the feet only. No text, letters, numbers, banner, compass, UI or routes. All assets sufficiently separated to cut apart. Entire image square.
prompts.background: Generate a NEW full-bleed 3:2 illustrated map BACKGROUND only. Reference image 2 shows the desired calm parchment map; reference image 1 is world-style context only. Warm pale parchment, quiet slightly irregular hand-inked cartography, very limited FLAT SVG-FRIENDLY colours. Main paper colour around #fbe7d4 / light warm ivory. A few faint tan gently curved contour strokes near the outer margins, a very faint meandering stream confined to the far right margin, a few tiny terrain dashes. At least 90% clear open paper, especially the entire central area. Absolutely no large coloured land blobs, no green-grey swatches, no dark water masses, no dramatic border or vignette. Paper is the map: no floating island or drawn sheet edges. No locations, buildings, trees, mountains, rocks, routes, dots, compass, labels or UI. Very subtle paper irregularity expressed in 4–6 broad cream/tan colours, not grain/noise or painterly texture. Cohesive with warm brown ink illustrations. Flat delicate art suitable for colour reduction into vector SVG.
prompts.travellerReference: Generate ONE original travelling map marker character for Little Gods. Reference 1 provides character/world identity; use it for inspiration without copying an existing god. A tiny friendly masked pilgrim, a cream leaf-shaped oval face with two simple dark eye slits beneath an oversized curvy brown hood, short chestnut cloak, little tan backpack, two distinct stubby boots visible under the cloak. Facing slightly right in three-quarter view, full body, compact upright silhouette. This will be an animated walking map token. Flat SVG-style: thick irregular warm brown curving outlines, ONLY 5–6 solid closed colour regions, cream face, tan/brown cloak, one ochre accent. No fine texture, no gradients, no shading realism, no ground or shadow, no circle/disc/pin enclosing the character, no text or UI. Genuine transparent background with generous clear padding. Exaggerated readable head and feet. One character only.
prompts.travellerSide:
Create a PAPER-DOLL PUPPET PARTS atlas of the attached Little Gods traveller. Preserve this exact character's cream leaf mask, brown hood/cloak, tan boots/backpack and warm-brown ink style, but simplify all gradients into flat vector-friendly colour shapes. We will rig and animate the separate parts. Actual transparent background. Exactly THREE ROWS × THREE COLUMNS of equal square cells, generous transparent gutters. Every separate part fully contained in its own cell. No assembled character anywhere.
Row1 left: complete HEAD, including the hood and cream mask, cut at the neck; no torso.
Row1 middle: TORSO ONLY, the brown cloak chest with its clasp, ending at the hem; NO head, arms, hands, legs or boots. Opaque silhouette, no holes where parts will attach.
Row1 right: tan BACKPACK ONLY, same backpack as reference.
Row2 left: LEFT ARM ONLY, short brown sleeve ending in a small tan mitten. Whole limb shoulder to hand, relaxed downward, with a rounded shoulder cap for overlap.
Row2 middle: RIGHT ARM ONLY, matching short brown sleeve and tan mitten, whole shoulder-to-hand limb.
Row2 right: a simple crooked brown WALKING STAFF only, no hand.
Row3 left: LEFT LEG AND BOOT only, short brown trouser leg ending in the large tan boot from the reference. Rounded upper joint hidden beneath cloak.
Row3 middle: RIGHT LEG AND BOOT only, same scale and proportions.
Row3 right: BACK CLOAK FLAP only, a small brown pointed fabric piece to sway behind the torso.
Each piece fully drawn with overlap allowance at its attachment, so no transparent holes appear when rotating. Facing the same three-quarter right direction as reference. Keep simple clean broad closed colour regions, 6–8 flat colours, no texture, no gradient, no shading realism. Charming curvy irregular ink contours, no rigid geometric precision. Do not add text, labels, gridlines, shadows or scenery. Square atlas.

prompts.banner: One blank label ribbon for a Little Gods illustrated map. Use attached artwork only as style reference: simple flat curvy SVG-style brown ink, not painted realism. A low, wide cream parchment strip with a long empty centre, two small folded tails and a slightly uneven gently bowed upper and lower edge. Very restrained shape, not ornate or frilly. Central writing area approximately 80% width; no decoration within it. Warm neutral ivory and tan, dark walnut brown outlines, only 4 flat colours, no orange/pink cast, no grey, no gradients, no texture. Genuine transparent background. Ribbon itself is about 5 times wider than high. Generous transparent margin. No text, lettering, symbols, shadow, ground or other objects. Original new artwork suitable for colour reduction and SVG conversion.
prompts.compass: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: isolated game map compass, to be vectorized into SVG. Primary request: one small hand-inked four-point compass rose for a sepia parchment fantasy map. Transparent background. Uneven gently curved pen outlines, modest slightly wonky handmade silhouette, simple broad flat cream and warm taupe fills, dark brown ink. All four points fully inside image with generous transparent padding. No lettering: our own font will supply N. No colour other than warm brown, taupe and cream. No surrounding map, no frame, no UI, no gradient, no shadow, no photorealism. Readable at 50 pixels, sparse detail. Single compass centered.

outputs: 40 SVG assets in assets/bramble-map; palette.json records the runtime recolouring mappings.
